name: mod
description: 5dive telemetry producer for Claude Code function hooks (early access). Publishes turn and session boundaries and the account's usage reading from inside the harness process to a per-seat JSONL sink, so the heartbeat, the pacing floor and the self-update's pending-restart sweep can read a first-class signal instead of inferring idle/busy from pane samples and the task board. Observe-only: it never denies, rewrites or delays a call. Off unless the seat opts in. On the NON-FRESH seats it can also compact the conversation at a turn boundary, so the next dispatched goal lands on a summary instead of the whole accumulated window; that half is off by default and pins any unanswered human gate or standing directive back into the compacted transcript.
